Name: Jonadab, Son of Shimeah
Summary: Jonadab, son of Shimeah, David's brother, was a very subtil man and Amnon's friend. He devised the trick by which Amnon lured Tamar into his chamber, and later assured David that only Amnon, not all his sons, had been slain.
KeyStory: Jonadab's clever plan put Tamar in Amnon's chamber — and his counsel was the crime's first step.
LifeLesson: Clever friends who plan another's sin share the guilt of it.
